title: Enable
text: Add enable port to subsystem or model, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets time interval; {States when enabling} selects block states when subsystem or model is disabled, {Propagate sizes of variable-size signals} selects when to propagate a variable-size signal Only when, {Show output port} controls display of output port for enable, {Enable zero-crossing detection} controls zero-crossing detection, {Port dimensions} sets the dimensions for the enable signal, {Minimum} sets the minimum output value for the enable signal, {Maximum} sets the maximum output value for the enable signal, {Data type} sets the output data type for the enable signal, {Mode} selects data type category and {Interpolate data} sets the value of missing workspace data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Enable signal
ports.summary: External enable signal for a subsystem or model scalar

params.name: States when enabling
params.values: Select block states when subsystem or model is disabled held (default) | reset

params.name: Propagate sizes of variable-size signals
params.values: Select when to propagate a variable-size signal Only when enabling (default) | During execution

params.name: Show output port
params.values: Control display of output port for enable signal off (default) | on

params.name: Port dimensions
params.values: Specify dimensions for the enable signal 1 (default) | [n] | [m n]

params.name: Minimum
params.values: Specify minimum output value for the enable signal [] (default) | real scalar

params.name: Maximum
params.values: Specify maximum output value for the enable signal [] (default) | real scalar

params.name: Data type
params.values: Specify output data type for the enable signal double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^,0) |

params.name: Mode
params.values: Select data type category Built in (default) | Fixed point | Expression

params.name: Interpolate data
params.values: Specify value of missing workspace data on (default) | off
